title: X3000

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The AGV X3000 combines relaxed road ergonomics with certified impact protection, pairing relaxed road ergonomics with modern certified protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1464g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~95 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Inspired by the historic models worn by Agostini.

variants.title: AGV X3000 Gloss Black
variants.description: The AGV X3000 is a benchmark Full Face helmet crafted in Italy 🇮🇹. Built around 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Race-bred Italian engineering born on the World Championship grid.

product_details.description: Inspired by the historic models worn by Agostini.

variants.introduction: Positioned in AGV's Full Face lineup, the X3000 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The AGV X3000 represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV X3000 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: AGV X3000 Gloss Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: AGV X3000 in AGV X3000 Gloss Black. An authentic retro-styled helmet engineered for cruiser enthusiasts who appreciate clean lines and comfortable road manners.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for an Intermediate Oval head shape with a semi-spherical shell; typically requires the standard AGV cheek pads which may feel slightly snug on very wide cheeks but offers excellent retention. The interior is lined with moisture-wicking fabric.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV X3000: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: AGV X3000: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV X3000. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV X3000 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
